mapper.insert: INSERT INTO setmeal (name, price, status, description, image, category_id, create_time, update_time,create_user,update_user) VALUES (#{name}, #{price}, #{status}, #{description}, #{image}, #{categoryId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime},#{createUser},#{updateUser})
mapper.update:
UPDATE setmeal
name = #{name},
price = #{price},
status = #{status},
description = #{description},
image = #{image},
category_id = #{categoryId},
update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser}
WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.price, s.status, s.description, s.image, s.category_id, s.update_time, s.create_time , category.name AS categoryName FROM setmeal s LEFT JOIN category ON s.category_id = category.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
